memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: initial assessment of anxiety, insomnia and newly diagnosed hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 25‑year‑old female vegetable vendor reports persistent worry, difficulty falling asleep, fatigue and cold intolerance for 3 months.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/72 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 158 cm, BMI 23.2 (overweight). Pulse regular, thyroid not enlarged, no tremor.
IMPRESSION: Generalised anxiety disorder (GAD‑7 12), insomnia (ISI 14), subclinical hypothyroidism (TSH 6.2 mIU/L, free T4 11.2 pmol/L). Haemoglobin 13.4 g/dL normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Order fasting TSH, free T4, haemoglobin, GAD‑7, ISI. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, suicidal thoughts, or worsening insomnia.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 6.2 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0), free T4 11.2 pmol/L (9.0‑17.0), haemoglobin 13.4 g/dL (12.0‑15.5), GAD‑7 score 12 (0‑21), Insomnia Severity Index score 14 (0‑28).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of initial treatment and symptom response.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient says anxiety somewhat better, sleep onset improved but still wakes 2‑3 times nightly, fatigue persists.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/74 mmHg, weight 58.5 kg, BMI 23.4 (overweight). No goiter, skin dry.
IMPRESSION: Partial response to escitalopram and buspirone; insomnia improving with melatonin/trazodone; levothyroxine 50 mcg OD insufficient as TSH remains elevated.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Continue current psych meds. Repeat TSH and free T4 in 6 weeks. Advise balanced diet, regular walks. Return if palpitations, heat intolerance, worsening anxiety, or new depressive symptoms.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 4.2 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0) borderline high, free T4 12.8 pmol/L (9.0‑17.0), haemoglobin 13.5 g/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: 3‑month follow‑up of anxiety, insomnia and thyroid replacement.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports feeling calmer, sleep latency <20 min, occasional early morning awakening; energy improved.
EXAMINATION: BP 119/71 mmHg, weight 59 kg, BMI 23.6 (overweight). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety well controlled (GAD‑7 8), insomnia mild (ISI 9), TSH 3.8 mIU/L now within target, free T4 13.0 pmol/L.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Reinforce diet and activity advice due to BMI ≥23. Return if weight gain >2 kg/month, palpitations, worsening mood, or severe insomnia.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 3.8 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0), free T4 13.0 pmol/L (9.0‑17.0), haemoglobin 13.6 g/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes slight increase in worry over work, sleep still good, no cold intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/73 mmHg, weight 60 kg, BMI 24.0 (overweight). No thyroid nodule.
IMPRESSION: GAD‑7 10 (moderate anxiety), ISI 8 (mild insomnia), euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD (TSH 3.2).
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase escitalopram to 10 mg OD for better anxiety control. Continue buspirone 5 mg BD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Give inactivated influenza vaccine today (05‑Nov‑2025). Advise diet, regular aerobic activity. Return if chest pain, dyspnoea, fever >39°C, suicidal ideation, or severe insomnia.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Escitalopram 10 mg OD
Buspirone 5 mg BD
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 50 mg HS
Levothyroxine 75 mcg OD

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: winter follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports stable mood, sleep 6‑7 hours nightly, occasional fatigue after long work hours.
EXAMINATION: BP 121/72 mmHg, weight 60.5 kg, BMI 24.2 (overweight). No goiter.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety controlled (GAD‑7 7), insomnia mild (ISI 7), thyroid euthyroid (TSH 2.9, free T4 13.5).
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Reinforce balanced diet, modest calorie reduction, and brisk walking 30 min daily. Return if new palpitations, heat intolerance, worsening anxiety/depression, or bleeding.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 2.9 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0), free T4 13.5 pmol/L (9.0‑17.0), haemoglobin 13.4 g/dL.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 10‑May‑2026 at 10:30 am with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: mid‑year review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes modest weight gain, feels more tired, sleep unchanged.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/75 mmHg, weight 62 kg, height 158 cm, BMI 24.8 (overweight, approaching obesity). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: GAD‑7 9, ISI 9, TSH 4.5 mIU/L slightly high, free T4 12.0 pmol/L low‑normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD. Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Advise dietary review, reduce refined carbs, increase activity. Return if palpitations, heat intolerance, worsening mood, or severe insomnia.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 4.5 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0), free T4 12.0 pmol/L (9.0‑17.0), haemoglobin 13.5 g/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review after thyroid dose change and pre‑winter.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports improved energy, sleep 7 hours, anxiety stable.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/73 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 24.6 (overweight). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety controlled (GAD‑7 8), insomnia mild (ISI 8), TSH now 2.8 mIU/L, free T4 13.2 pmol/L – euthyroid.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, levothyroxine 100 mcg OD. Influenza vaccine due next autumn; remind patient. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, suicidal thoughts, or severe insomnia.
